name: @cvmpay/components
description: Invoice, invoice form and pay button components for cvmpay, for React, Solid, Svelte 5 and Svelte 4.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && npm run build:react && npm run build:solid && npm run build:svelte5 && npm run build:svelte4 && cp src/styles.css dist/styles.css && node scripts/self-types.mjs
scripts.build:svelte4: mkdir -p dist/svelte4 && cp src/svelte4/*.svelte src/svelte4/index.js src/svelte4/index.d.ts dist/svelte4/
scripts.test: vitest run --coverage --project react --project solid --project svelte && vitest run --project react-ssr --project solid-ssr --project svelte-ssr
scripts.lint:package: publint && attw --pack . --profile esm-only --exclude-entrypoints styles.css svelte5 && attw --pack . --profile esm-only --entrypoints svelte5 --ignore-rules internal-resolution-error
scripts.e2e: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.react.json --noEmit --customConditions cvmpay-source && tsc -p tsconfig.solid.json --noEmit --customConditions cvmpay-source && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.svelte.json --threshold error
